However the requirement specifically "one of the writers was academic staff of Harran University." If we separate: (a) existence of academic staff at Harran, (b) as of 2023, (c) one is writer. C1 supports (a) for a person, but not date or writer. Is (a) substantive material part? It could be. But the "person" must be one of writers. Otherwise it's unrelated. The requirement asks about one writer being Harran academic staff. Without linking to writer, it's just a candidate mention. So unsupported. But if there is only one claim, all others unsupported.
